cases.summary: Mother of Xun Jiang is a valid unnamed family record entailed by 外祖孫謙 addressing Xun Jiang in s0050, but 荀匠母 is an editorial Chinese gloss not quoted in source. No 母 name surface appears in the sealed unit.

rejectedWitnesses.reason: Editorial descriptive label; s0050 reads 外祖孫謙誡之曰 and does not contain 荀匠母 or a standalone 母 naming the mother.

primaryWitnesses.zhContext: 外祖孫謙誡之曰：「主上以孝治天下，汝行過古人，故發明詔，擢汝此職。
primaryWitnesses.witnessUse: Names Sun Qian as Xun Jiang's maternal grandfather; supports maternal line without naming the mother.

primaryWitnesses.zhContext: 外祖孫謙誡之曰：「主上以孝治天下，汝行過古人，故發明詔，擢汝此職。
primaryWitnesses.witnessUse: Personal name of the quoted maternal grandfather witness.
Apostrophic address to Xun Jiang (匠); does not supply the mother's name or the morpheme 母.

distinctions: p025 Sun Qian is explicitly named in s0050.
p026 remains an inferred maternal parent between Sun Qian and Xun Jiang.
Grandfather speech must not be misread as a mother name witness.

patches.reason: Bind descriptive kinship to 外祖 structure via p025 on s0050, not to a fabricated name quote.
